en.name: Database studio
en.description: Manage local MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite and MongoDB connections. Browse schemas, edit records, run SQL or Extended JSON, and share query drafts with agents. Requires a desktop App with database capabilities; credentials and results stay on this computer.

zh.name: 数据库工作台
zh.description: 连接 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite 与 MongoDB，管理本机连接、浏览结构、增删改查及执行 SQL 或 Extended JSON。可与 agent 共享查询草稿；凭证与结果留在本机，需支持数据库能力的桌面 App。
